summary: UI component package exposes unauthenticated remote shell via WebSocket-driven PTY
details: The package advertises itself as a UI component library ("UI Tools / Kind of like MUI") but exports a `useTerminal` middleware that stands up a WebSocketServer and spawns an interactive shell (bash on Linux/macOS, powershell.exe on Windows) via node-pty with `cwd` set to the server user's HOME directory. Bytes from every incoming WebSocket message are passed directly into `session.ptyProcess.write(parsed.data)` with no authentication, token check, or origin validation on the handshake. Any client that can reach the mounted middleware path obtains an unauthenticated interactive shell running as the server process on the host. The remote-shell capability is not documented in the package's stated purpose as a UI component toolkit.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
